**Dance Vision**, translated from .nfo: your phone becomes a motion-capture rig and your telly becomes a dance floor. Scan a QR code, prop the phone against the TV, and you turn up as a stick figure in a shared room with everyone else who joined. The pose model runs in the phone's browser and only joint positions travel to the PC, so there is no app, no account, and no video ever leaves your phone. The TV side, Studio, is just another browser window you drag onto the telly.

<details>
<summary><b>[ READ THE REST OF THE .NFO ]</b> &nbsp;what's in the box, release notes, requirements, history</summary>

<pre>
──[ <b>WHAT'S iN THE BOX</b> ]─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  <b>/controller</b> ...... the PC remote. library, playback, players, settings
  <b>/studio</b> .......... the telly. three.js room, music, choreography, relay
  <b>/camera.html</b> ..... the phone. camera + pose model. the QR lands here
  <b>/mapper</b> .......... dance map editor. waveform, move picker, publish

──[ <b>RELEASE NOTES</b> ]─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  + you turn up as a stick figure next to a backing crew who idle like they
    are queueing for a club, then dance once the music actually starts.
  + six East London venues, each with a spotlight moment: every minute or so a
    10 second countdown names a dancer, then they get the camera, a spin and a
    cheering crew. the Midnight Studio stays the default. press V on the telly
    to cycle.
  + YouTube dance videos can be downloaded, reviewed and mapped into editable
    choreography in /mapper. see <a href="YOUTUBE_WORKFLOW.md">YOUTUBE_WORKFLOW.md</a>.
  + camera pixels never leave the phone. the relay carries landmarks, and
    phones get room state back, never each other's poses.

──[ <b>PROTECTiON</b> ]────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  none. no DRM, no login, no video uploads. the only thing tracking you is you.

──[ <b>REQUiREMENTS</b> ]──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  the PC ...... Node + npm, a browser, an HDMI cable
  the telly ... anything with an HDMI port
  the phones .. a browser with a camera that reaches the PC over
                https. plain http on the LAN will not open the camera.
                setup: <a href="docs/MULTIPLAYER.md">docs/MULTIPLAYER.md</a>
  dignity ..... optional

──[ <b>HiSTORY</b> ]───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  2021 ........ Unity prototype: 3 players on webcams, instructor on the wall
  2026-09-13 .. first browser build. one webcam, on-device, 18 fps
  2026-09 ..... phones, the telly, dance maps, six venues. you are here
